<div class="tg-text"><b>Alhamdulillah</b><br/><br/>I am truly honored to share that our research has been accepted for publication in <a href="https://link.springer.com/journal/11135" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Quality &amp; Quantity</a> (Springer Nature)  a Q1 journal ranked 19th out of 285 in its field (SCIE &amp; Scopus indexed).<br/><br/><blockquote>This project examines an urgent global question:<br/>Why is the transition to renewable energy progressing at different speeds across countries?<br/><br/>In our paper, “Structural drivers and distributional inequality in global renewable energy adoption” (2026, article in press), we show that the world risks moving toward a “two-speed” energy transition. While some economies accelerate rapidly, others remain structurally constrained.
